versions.changelog: Add Moltbook/OpenClaw community distribution docs; agent can install from distribute/skill.md

- Initial release of yg3-marketing-mcp skill.
- Enables provisioning of YG3 marketing workspaces with no human signup or OAuth required.
- Access 200+ MCP tools for content generation, SEO, website creation, outbound marketing, LinkedIn, and ads.
- Includes endpoints for workspace claiming, cleanup, and core MCP operations.
- Sandbox: unclaimed workspaces publish to subdomain, expire in 14 days, and include some feature restrictions.
